title: Moving away
text: I left my hometown with mixed feelings. I was scared to leave my family but excited to start a new chapter.

title: Family dinner
text: We had a joyful family dinner. I laughed with my cousins and felt grateful for everyone.

title: Losing a friend
text: When my friend passed away, I felt deep sadness and emptiness. The memory still hurts.

title: First job
text: My first job interview made me nervous, but later I felt proud when I got the offer.

title: Accident
text: I had a small accident on the road. I was frightened, but I stayed calm and got help quickly.
